newsitem.title: UK: Saudi raises Berri crude 15 cts to Asia in Februar.
newsitem.headline: Saudi raises Berri crude 15 cts to Asia in Februar.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has raised the price of Berri Extra Light crude by 15 cents a barrel to $2.15 above Oman and Dubai crudes for Asian customers in February, trade sources said on Thursday.

Saudi Arabian Light was left unchanged at 75 cents above Oman and Dubai crudes while Saudi Medium and Heavy crudes were also left unchanged at 30 cents and $1.15 below Oman and dubai respectively. There was no immediate information regarding Arab Super Light crude prices.
